name: The Sepulcher upper inn starts resting for a Horde character (#10677)
contract: Area trigger 5850 (AreaTrigger.dbc 425.51, 1621.24, 139.32, radius 25) covers the upper inn of The Sepulcher, where #10677 stood at (434.80, 1625.41, 141.88), 102 yd from the stock tavern trigger 720. The server had neither an areatrigger nor an areatrigger_tavern row for 5850, so the client's trigger packet was dropped and resting never started. rev_20261124_10677 adds the trigger from the DBC and the tavern row with the Horde mask of 720, so entering the trigger now rests a Horde character.

steps.label: DISCRIMINATING: entering the upper inn trigger starts resting
